missing: Named quiet power stations (and quiet inverter generators) with measured noise levels in dB, capacity and runtime for typical outage loads, current prices, and a direct pick by budget.
why: Consumer Reports does lab-test power stations and its buying guide names them as the alternative, but it only does that in general terms, with no picks or noise figures in the text. That makes it one major reviewer answering part of the question. Everything else is a retailer guide, generic niche explainers with no products, itechguides pages that are mostly Amazon product widgets, safety pages and unreadable PDFs. A page that ranks quiet power stations by measured noise, capacity and price could get in, but it would compete with CR.
